title: Our Home
text:
My family lives in a small house. We have a big kitchen and a red door. My mother cooks dinner every evening. We eat together at seven o'clock.

My father works in a shop. He likes to read books after work. My sister is ten years old. She plays with our dog in the garden.

questions.text: How does the family probably feel about eating dinner together?
options: They are happy to spend time together
They are angry about the dinner
They are sad because the food is bad
They are bored with the family

questions.text: What is the sister probably like?
options: She is playful and likes animals

vocabulary.definition: a room where food is cooked
with another person or other people
a piece of land near a house where plants or flowers grow
at a later time than something else

paragraph_translations: Моя родина живе в маленькому будинку. У нас є велика кухня і червоні двері. Моя мама готує вечерю кожного вечора. Ми їмо разом о сьомій годині.
Мій тато працює в магазині. Після роботи він любить читати книги. Моїй сестрі десять років. Вона грає з нашим собакою в саду.
